biotools.summary: 3D-spaGNN-E is a pipeline that develops spatially resolved gene neighborhood network embedding to identify subcellular gene proximity relationships and key subcellular motifs in cell-cell communication. It combines 3D imaging-based spatial transcriptomics and graph-based deep learning.
